title: Boston Fishing Charter | Striped Bass & Bluefish

services.name: Charter Info
services.desc: Trips are limited to 6 passengers to provide the best fishing experience for every guest. Multiple charter discounts may be available. Contact the captain when booking for details. Our Boston fishing charters target striped bass and bluefish (when available) in the productive waters of Boston Harbor and the surrounding Massachusetts coastline. These species provide exciting action and are the most popular sportfish for anglers visiting Boston. Our trips are designed for anglers of all experience levels, from beginners to experienced fishermen looking to catch trophy Boston Harbor striped bass.
